# Music Prompt Engineering Skill

Source methodology adapted from `sanic732/SunoForge` (MIT). Do not treat third-party platform behavior as permanent; verify current platform facts before stating them.

## Goal
Turn a plain-language musical brief into a precise, original generation brief.

## Workflow
- Clarify genre, emotional arc, vocal character, instrumentation, tempo feel and structure only when useful.
- Prefer melody/hook intent before technical parameter overload.
- Describe sections independently when arrangement changes matter.
- Keep lyrics, production direction and platform prompt separated when that improves reuse.
- Preserve originality; do not request an exact imitation of a living artist.

## Quality gate
- one clear musical identity;
- memorable hook or motif;
- coherent section progression;
- singable language;
- no invented claims about a generator's current capabilities.
